lines.text: God says Jerusalem clings to deceit, and everyone pursues his own course like a horse charging into battle.
The stork knows her seasons, but God's people do not know His requirements, and the priests have a lying pen.
From prophet to priest all practice deceit, and they have no shame and do not know how to blush.
God will take away their harvest, and the people say they will flee to the high mountains and perish there.
The snorting of enemy horses is heard from Dan, and God will send vipers that cannot be charmed.
